requirement: Implement Build Tracker rows 0.4 and 0.5: the shared token/resource layer plus capsule and eye geometry helpers.

architecture.decision: Keep authored data in .tres resources and procedural math in core class_name helpers; Tokens remains the Doc 00-required autoload for globally shared, immutable constants.
alternatives: Place palette and proportion values in the Tokens singleton
Duplicate geometry formulas in rig scenes
tradeoffs: Resources keep per-zone/per-character overrides inspectable and serializable; static helpers make shared geometry deterministic and easy to test.
seams: Palette owns colors and ambient weirdness only; Weirdness owns the global grade in tracker row 0.6.
CharacterProportions provides segment dimensions; Tube and Eyes consume raw values without scene dependencies.
tests/test_all.gd remains the sole test-suite entry point.

tasks.title: Create the shared token and resource layer
tasks.intent: Make the Doc 01 color palette and humanoid proportions available as reusable Godot Resources, with Tokens registered as the constants autoload.
constraints: Use the locked Doc 01 values and names.
Do not implement Weirdness; it is tracker row 0.6.
Keep test failures explicit through RuntimeHarness rather than bare assert().
tasks.acceptance: Tokens autoloads, Palette and CharacterProportions are loadable resources, pal_woods.tres loads with its woods baseline, and Dipper's shared segment stack remains within the Doc 01 §11 tolerance of declared height.
tasks.result: Tokens is registered as an autoload; pal_woods.tres and prop_dipper.tres load through their typed resources; the Doc 01 segment-stack tolerance holds.

tasks.title: Create deterministic tube and eye geometry helpers
tasks.intent: Provide the one-polygon hose capsule, blend weights, UV helpers, and clamped touching-eye math that rigs later consume.
constraints: Tube shaft subdivisions must preserve four or more vertices in the elbow blend band.
Use one continuous capsule, never separate upper/fore-limb geometry.
Keep all geometry scene-independent and class_name-addressable.
tasks.acceptance: Doc 01 §11 capsule bounds, winding/vertex-count, UV, weight-partition, blend-band, and pupil-containment checks pass.
tasks.result: Tube and Eyes provide deterministic capsule/UV/weight and eye/pupil geometry; the 28-vertex default places six vertices in the required blend band.
